priorities.evidence: CSE2ALG assessments show persistent gaps in implementing data structures (47.0-49.0%) with feedback highlighting 'implementing data structures and searching and sorting algorithms in Java' and 'comparing algorithms' as key issues.
priorities.actions: Revisit CSE2ALG:Test feedback on SILO3 implementation; practice Java exercises for sorting algorithms; review CSE2ALG:Assignment feedback on SILO5 performance measures.

priorities.evidence: All CSE1OOF assessments (50.0-56.0%) show consistent gaps in 'abstract data types and encapsulation' and 'code sharing and reuse' with feedback emphasizing 'applying concepts more consistently'.
priorities.actions: Revisit CSE1OOF:Assignment feedback on SILO2; redo practical exercises on encapsulation; review CSE1OOF:Test feedback on SILO3.

priorities.evidence: CSE3CAP assessments (50.0-56.0%) indicate gaps in 'professional system documentation' and 'reporting outcomes' with feedback noting 'needs greater consistency' in technical reporting.
priorities.actions: Revisit CSE3CAP:Assignment feedback on SILO4; practice documenting Java code; review CSE3CAP:Oral presentation feedback on SILO3.
